verdict.rationale: a-Shell is itself an official Unix-like command-line terminal for iOS. It ships first-party commands such as `pkg install`, `config`, `pickFolder`, `bookmark`, and `help -l` for command discovery. Its Apple Shortcuts `Execute Command` action lets automation workflows drive the shell programmatically. missing for 10: AI-oriented affordances such as machine-readable/JSON output or agent-focused documentation (llms.txt returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of use in AI-driven workflows.
